title: JoyAI-Image: Unified Multimodal Foundation Model
summary: A unified open-source model by JD Open Source that integrates image understanding, generation, and precise instruction-guided editing. It combines an 8B reasoning VLM with a 16B diffusion transformer to perform complex spatial manipulations like object relocation.
research_notes: Supports advanced editing tasks including object rotation, 3D camera adjustments, and high-fidelity text rendering. The reasoning engine is based on Qwen3-VL.

evolution.summary: Released official ComfyUI and Diffusers library support in April 2026. Published a comprehensive technical report and the OpenSpatial-3M dataset in May 2026 to facilitate research into spatially-aware image editing and camera control.
